outcome: The presheaf construction is not full on arbitrary geometric morphisms, although the simplicial nerve is fully faithful. For D=(Z,≤), filtered colimit on Psh(D) is a point inverse image preserving finite limits and all colimits; it sends every representable to a singleton and cannot be evaluation at any integer. This supplies the concrete negative answer. The representable/essential-point framework is checked in the original SGA pages, not in later machine translations.
